acceptanceCriteria: A dispatched lane's handoff note carries the full commit SHA.
The packet checkpoint for that lane reports commitBinding OBSERVED, with a test or retained run evidence.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1432 (review-1021c, seal head 5cbdef8ac, base 0106d06cd). Parent V1-1921 added the optional full `commit` to the handoff note and a packet checkpoint commitBinding OBSERVED plus commitRelation. Expected: the dispatcher (internal/tasks/dispatch/handoff_note.go) writes the full commit. Actual: it never writes it, so commitBinding stays NOT_OBSERVED in practice.

completion.reason: Delivered by lane PR #1516; merged in batch PR #1525 at 1125ad00ef59f1a26c0edf02b9932c2c365d62a4; CI green: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/39723618364

title: Dispatcher does not write the handoff note `commit` field, so packet checkpoint commitBinding stays NOT_OBSERVED (V1-1921 follow-up)
